test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"to."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"To"** is the correct preposition to use when indicating movement or direction towards a specific destination.

 
 
• **Example**:* "I am going **to**__ the store."*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.​
 
• Correct passage:

An 'occupational disease' is any disease __caused__ primarily by exposure at work __to__ a physical, organisational, chemical or biological risk ______ (3) ______ or to a combination of these factors. Occupational diseases are ______ (4) ______ those listed in national legislation as resulting from exposure to risk factors at ______ (5) ______.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"In"** is used to indicate being inside a specific place or time.

 
 
• **Example**: *"I am **in**__ the room."*
 
 
 
• **"On"** is used to indicate being in contact with a surface or a specific day/date.
 __
 
• **Example**:* "The book is **on**__ the table."*
 
 
 
• **"Of"** is used to indicate possession or relationship between two things.
 __
 
• **Example**: *"The cover **of**__ the book." *
